function: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase involved in postreplication repair of UV-damaged DNA. Postreplication repair functions in gap-filling of a daughter strand on replication of damaged DNA. Associates to the E2 ubiquitin conjugating enzyme UBE2B to form the UBE2B-RAD18 ubiquitin ligase complex involved in mono-ubiquitination of DNA-associated PCNA on 'Lys-164'. Has ssDNA binding activity.

subcellular_location: Nucleus; Cytoplasm; Cytoskeleton; Microtubule organizing center; Centrosome; Associates with chromatin (PubMed:25931565). Colocalizes with SLF1 in the nucleus and to centrosomes (PubMed:15632077). Relocalizes with SLF1 to nuclear foci in response to DNA damage (PubMed:22036607). Accumulates with the SLF1-SLF2 and SMC5-SMC6 complexes at replication-coupled DNA interstrand repair and DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) sites on chromatin in a ubiquitin-dependent manner (PubMed:25931565).
subunit: Homodimer (PubMed:21549715). Interacts with UBE2A and UBE2B, one homodimer binding one molecule of UBE2B. Interacts with SHPRH (PubMed:17108083, PubMed:17130289). Interacts with HLTF (PubMed:18316726, PubMed:18719106). Interacts with SPRTN; leading to enhance chromatin association of RAD18 and RAD18-mediated PCNA ubiquitination and translesion DNA synthesis (PubMed:22681887). Interacts (via C-terminus and phosphorylated form) with SLF1 (via BRCT domains); this interaction is required for efficient repair of UV-induced DNA damage (PubMed:15632077, PubMed:22036607, PubMed:25931565). Interacts with SLF2 (PubMed:25931565). Interacts with SMC5; this interaction is increased in a SLF1 or SLF2-dependent manner (PubMed:25931565). Interacts with DNA damage up-regulated protein DDUP (PubMed:35849344). Forms a complex with DDUP and H2AX following DDUP phosphorylation (PubMed:35849344).

annotation.organism: Emericella nidulans (strain FGSC A4 / ATCC 38163 / CBS 112.46 / NRRL 194 / M139)
function: Together with the E2 ubiquitin conjugating enzyme uvsJ/ubc2, monoubiquitinates PCNA to promote two parallel branches of the DNA damage tolerance (DDT) pathway (also known as the post-replication repair (PRR) pathway) that bypasses replication-blocking lesions without removing them; monoubiquitination promotes the translesion synthesis (TLS) pathway and leads to the recruitment of translesion polymerases for lesion bypass, whereas further polyubiquitination of PCNA promotes template-switching (TS) to the newly synthesized sister chromatid for synthesis past the lesion.

annotation.protein_name: Postreplication repair E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RAD18
function: Together with the E2 ubiquitin conjugating enzyme UBC2, monoubiquitinates PCNA to promote two parallel branches of the DNA damage tolerance (DDT) pathway (also known as the post-replication repair (PRR) pathway) that bypasses replication-blocking lesions without removing them; monoubiquitination promotes the translesion synthesis (TLS) pathway and leads to the recruitment of translesion polymerases for lesion bypass, whereas further polyubiquitination of PCNA promotes template-switching (TS) to the newly synthesized sister chromatid for synthesis past the lesion.
